examples.text: 理由就是重大公关事故。
examples.trans: The reason is a major public-relations incident.

examples.text: 这是一个非常重大的决定。
examples.trans: This is a major decision.

examples.text: 最重要的部门还是这边，淳于乔领导的制作部。
examples.trans: Still, the most important department is right here: the production unit led by Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 这是重要。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 重要.

meanings.note: Noun fēngshēng (as in 走漏风声, 'leak word').

examples.text: 是你们自己走漏了风声，才让我有了线索。
examples.trans: Your own team leaked word of it, giving me the trail.

examples.text: 新节目的嘉宾阵容目前一点风声都没露。
examples.trans: Not a whisper of the new guest lineup has leaked yet.
